info.name: CAMT.053 End-to-End Demo
info.description:
Walks through the full CAMT.053 parsing pipeline:
1. Create FileSpec
2. Create SFTP + Kafka integrations
3. Create & enable a Profile
4. Open a window
5. Simulate file arrival
6. Monitor execution

IDs are automatically captured from each response and injected into later requests — just run the folders in order.

Set the `baseUrl` variable to your target environment before running (default: http://localhost:8080).

variable.description: Base URL of the Transform Platform API

item.name: Step 1 — Create CAMT.053 FileSpec

body.raw:
{
  "name": "CAMT.053 Bank Statement Entry",
  "description": "ISO 20022 BankToCustomerStatement - Ntry level parser",
  "version": "1.0",
  "format": "ISO20022",
  "encoding": "UTF-8",
  "hasHeader": false,
  "fields": [
    {
      "name": "statementId",
      "displayName": "Statement ID",
      "type": "STRING",
      "path": "/Document/BkToCstmrStmt/Stmt/Id",
      "required": true,
      "description": "Unique statement identifier from the bank"
    },
    {
      "name": "iban",
      "displayName": "IBAN",
      "type": "STRING",
      "path": "/Document/BkToCstmrStmt/Stmt/Acct/Id/IBAN",
      "required": true,
      "description": "IBAN of the account the statement belongs to"
    },
    {
      "name": "currency",
      "displayName": "Currency",
      "type": "STRING",
      "path": "/Document/BkToCstmrStmt/Stmt/Acct/Ccy",
      "required": false,
      "defaultValue": "USD",
      "description": "ISO 4217 currency code for the account"
    },
    {
      "name": "entryRef",
      "displayName": "Entry Reference",
      "type": "STRING",
      "path": "/Document/BkToCstmrStmt/Stmt/Ntry/NtryRef",
      "required": true,
      "description": "Bank-assigned reference for this entry (debit or credit)"
    },
    {
      "name": "amount",
      "displayName": "Amount",
      "type": "AMOUNT",
      "path": "/Document/BkToCstmrStmt/Stmt/Ntry/Amt",
      "required": true,
      "scale": 2,
      "description": "Transaction amount"
    },
    {
      "name": "creditDebitIndicator",
      "displayName": "Credit/Debit",
      "type": "ENUM",
      "path": "/Document/BkToCstmrStmt/Stmt/Ntry/CdtDbtInd",
      "required": true,
      "allowedValues": ["CRDT", "DBIT"],
      "description": "CRDT = credit (money in); DBIT = debit (money out)"
    },
    {
      "name": "bookingDate",
      "displayName": "Booking Date",
      "type": "DATE",
      "path": "/Document/BkToCstmrStmt/Stmt/Ntry/BookgDt/Dt",
      "required": false,
      "format": "yyyy-MM-dd",
      "description": "Date the entry was booked on the bank ledger"
    },
    {
      "name": "valueDate",
      "displayName": "Value Date",
      "type": "DATE",
      "path": "/Document/BkToCstmrStmt/Stmt/Ntry/ValDt/Dt",
      "required": false,
      "format": "yyyy-MM-dd",
      "description": "Value date (when funds are available)"
    },
    {
      "name": "bankTxCode",
      "displayName": "Bank Transaction Code",
      "type": "STRING",
      "path": "/Document/BkToCstmrStmt/Stmt/Ntry/BkTxCd/Domn/Cd",
      "required": false,
      "description": "Bank-specific transaction code domain (e.g. PMNT)"
    },
    {
      "name": "txFamily",
      "displayName": "Transaction Family",
      "type": "STRING",
      "path": "/Document/BkToCstmrStmt/Stmt/Ntry/BkTxCd/Domn/Fmly/Cd",
      "required": false,
      "description": "Transaction family code (e.g. ICDT = Inward Credit Transfer)"
    },
    {
      "name": "endToEndId",
      "displayName": "End-to-End ID",
      "type": "STRING",
      "path": "/Document/BkToCstmrStmt/Stmt/Ntry/NtryDtls/TxDtls/Refs/EndToEndId",
      "required": false,
      "description": "End-to-end reference from the original payment instruction"
    },
    {
      "name": "remittanceInfo",
      "displayName": "Remittance Information",
      "type": "STRING",
      "path": "/Document/BkToCstmrStmt/Stmt/Ntry/NtryDtls/TxDtls/RmtInf/Ustrd",
      "required": false,
      "maxLength": 140,
      "description": "Unstructured remittance info (payment reference text)"
    },
    {
      "name": "debtorName",
      "displayName": "Debtor Name",
      "type": "STRING",
      "path": "/Document/BkToCstmrStmt/Stmt/Ntry/NtryDtls/TxDtls/RltdPties/Dbtr/Nm",
      "required": false,
      "description": "Name of the debtor party"
    },
    {
      "name": "debtorIban",
      "displayName": "Debtor IBAN",
      "type": "STRING",
      "path": "/Document/BkToCstmrStmt/Stmt/Ntry/NtryDtls/TxDtls/RltdPties/DbtrAcct/Id/IBAN",
      "required": false,
      "sensitive": true,
      "description": "IBAN of the debtor account (masked in logs)"
    },
    {
      "name": "creditorName",
      "displayName": "Creditor Name",
      "type": "STRING",
      "path": "/Document/BkToCstmrStmt/Stmt/Ntry/NtryDtls/TxDtls/RltdPties/Cdtr/Nm",
      "required": false,
      "description": "Name of the creditor party"
    }
  ],
  "validationRules": [
    {
      "ruleId": "vr-001",
      "field": "amount",
      "ruleType": "MIN_VALUE",
      "value": "0",
      "message": "Amount must be non-negative",
      "severity": "ERROR"
    },
    {
      "ruleId": "vr-002",
      "field": "entryRef",
      "ruleType": "NOT_EMPTY",
      "message": "Entry reference must not be empty",
      "severity": "ERROR"
    },
    {
      "ruleId": "vr-003",
      "field": "iban",
      "ruleType": "REGEX",
      "value": "^[A-Z]{2}[0-9]{2}[A-Z0-9]{4}[0-9]{7}([A-Z0-9]?){0,16}$",
      "message": "IBAN format invalid",
      "severity": "WARNING"
    }
  ],
  "correctionRules": [
    {
      "ruleId": "cr-001",
      "field": "remittanceInfo",
      "correctionType": "TRIM",
      "applyOrder": 1
    },
    {
      "ruleId": "cr-002",
      "field": "debtorName",
      "correctionType": "TRIM",
      "applyOrder": 2
    }
  ],
  "metadata": {
    "standard": "ISO 20022",
    "messageType": "camt.053.001.02",
    "namespace": "urn:iso:std:iso:20022:tech:xsd:camt.053.001.02",
    "source": "Goldman Sachs TxB sample"
  }
}

request.description:
Defines the CAMT.053 ISO 20022 XML structure with all 15 fields, 3 validation rules, and 2 correction rules.

The response `id` is automatically saved to the `specId` collection variable for use in Step 3.

item.description: Creates the FileSpec that drives XML parsing, validation, and correction for CAMT.053 BankToCustomerStatement messages.

item.name: Step 2 — Create Service Integrations

request.description:
Registers the Goldman Sachs SFTP endpoint as an inbound file source.

Required fields: `type`, `userId`, `shortDescription`, `updatedBy`, `details`.
SFTP details: `directories` is an array of remote paths to poll; `filters` is an array of Ant-style glob patterns.

The response `id` is automatically saved to the `sftpIntegrationId` collection variable.

item.name: 2b — Set Kafka Topic Config (no API call needed)

exec: // KAFKA is not an IntegrationType in this platform.
// Supported types are: SFTP, FTP, S3 — file-polling integrations only.
// Kafka publishing uses the broker already wired into the app via
// KAFKA_BROKERS env var (application.yml). The NOTIFY step in the
// profile references a topic name directly — no integration row needed.
// We store the topic as kafkaIntegrationId so Step 3 can reference
console.log('✅ Kafka topic set to: bank.statement.entries (no registration needed)');
// This is a no-op GET — only the pre-request script matters here.
// The GET /api/v1/integrations call just confirms the server is reachable.
console.log('✅ kafkaIntegrationId variable set to: bank.statement.entries');

request.description:
ℹ️ KAFKA is not a supported IntegrationType (only SFTP, FTP, S3 are).

Kafka publishing is handled by the application's built-in Kafka producer (configured via KAFKA_BROKERS in application.yml / docker-compose env). No separate integration row is required.

This step uses a pre-request script to set `kafkaIntegrationId` = `bank.statement.entries` (the topic name) so Step 3's NOTIFY step config can reference it.

The GET request itself is just a health-check — the real work happens in the pre-request script.

item.description:
Creates both the SFTP source (where CAMT.053 files arrive) and the Kafka sink (where parsed entries are published).

Run 2a before 2b — both IDs are required for Step 3.

item.name: Step 3 — Create Profile

request.description:
Creates the ACME Bank Statement Pipeline profile. References:
- `{{specId}}` — from Step 1
- `{{sftpIntegrationId}}` — from Step 2a
- `{{kafkaIntegrationId}}` — from Step 2b

The profile defines:
- Open trigger: daily cron at 06:00 UTC
- Close trigger: FILE_ARRIVAL on the SFTP integration
- Action chain: PARSE_FILE → VALIDATE → NOTIFY (Kafka)
- ON_ERROR alert to Slack webhook

The response `id` is saved to `profileId`.

item.description: Creates the profile that wires the FileSpec, SFTP source, and Kafka sink together into a complete pipeline. Must run after Steps 1 and 2.

item.name: Step 4 — Enable Profile & Verify Window

exec: console.log('✅ Profile enabled — Quartz trigger registered');

request.description: Enables the profile: registers the Quartz cron trigger and creates the first PENDING window scheduled for the next 06:00 UTC fire time.

Confirms the window was created in PENDING state after enabling the profile.

Expected: one window with status=PENDING and a scheduledOpenAt of the next 06:00 UTC.

item.description: Activates the profile and verifies the Quartz scheduler created a PENDING window.

item.name: Step 5 — Open Window (dev trigger)

request.description:
Dev shortcut: opens the window immediately instead of waiting for the 06:00 UTC cron.

In production this is triggered automatically by the Quartz job at scheduledOpenAt.

The response windowId is saved to the `windowId` collection variable.

item.description: Manually opens the window for immediate testing — bypasses the cron schedule.

item.name: Step 6 — Simulate File Arrival

exec: console.log('✅ File arrival recorded — watch for workflow execution in Step 7');

request.description:
Simulates the SFTP listener posting a file arrival event. In production this is called automatically by the platform-integration SFTP poller.

After this call:
1. FileArrivalTriggerEvaluator detects the file matches `camt053_*.xml`
2. Window transitions OPEN → CLOSING
3. ActionChainExecutor creates a WorkflowExecution
4. Quartz picks up and runs: PARSE_FILE → VALIDATE → NOTIFY

item.description: Simulates a CAMT.053 file landing on the SFTP integration, which fires the window close trigger and kicks off the action chain.

item.name: Step 7 — Monitor Execution

request.description:
Lists all workflow executions created for this window. The first execution ID is saved to `execId` for the detail view.

Expected: one execution for the ON_FILE_ARRIVED action chain with status PENDING, RUNNING, or COMPLETED.

Returns the full execution with step-level detail.

Expected step flow:
  Step 1: Parse CAMT.053 XML  → COMPLETED
  Step 2: Validate entries    → COMPLETED
  Step 3: Publish to Kafka    → COMPLETED
  Overall: COMPLETED

Re-run this request until status = COMPLETED.

Verifies the INBOUND file_log entry for camt053_20260322.xml.

Expected: one entry with direction=INBOUND and status=RECEIVED or PROCESSED.

item.description:
Polls the execution to watch the 3-step action chain progress through PARSE_FILE → VALIDATE → NOTIFY.

Run 7a first to capture the execId, then 7b for step detail. Re-run 7b until status = COMPLETED.
